thought.text: Ada satu hal aneh: solusi CaptchaFox ter-nested ganda. Saya perbaiki cara membacanya dan tes.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 - <<'PY'
p='capsolve.py'; t=open(p).read()
t=t.replace('''def solve_captchafox(url, sitekey, **kw):
    """sitekey format `sk_...`. GMX: sk_vKdD8WGlPF5FKpRDs1U4qTuu6Jv0w"""
    s = _run({"type": "CaptchaFoxTaskProxyLess", "websiteURL": url, "websiteKey": sitekey}, **kw)
    return s["token"] if isinstance(s.get("solution"), dict) is False else s["solution"]["token"]''',
'''def solve_captchafox(url, sitekey, **kw):
    """sitekey format `sk_...`. GMX: sk_vKdD8WGlPF5FKpRDs1U4qTuu6Jv0w

    Respons CaptchaFox ter-nested ganda: solution.solution.token
    """
    s = _run({"type": "CaptchaFoxTaskProxyLess", "websiteURL": url, "websiteKey": sitekey}, **kw)
    inner = s.get("solution") if isinstance(s.get("solution"), dict) else s
    return inner.get("token") or inner''')
open(p,'w').write(t); print("patched")

echo "=== tes ulang semua solver ==="; for c in "balance" "turnstile https://hexapi.io 0x4AAAAAAF3EU-q7sNrfjP5Q" "captchafox https://signup.gmx.com/ sk_vKdD8WGlPF5FKpRDs1U4qTuu6Jv0w"; do printf "%-14s " "${c%% *}"; timeout 120 python3 capsolve.py $c 2>&1 | head -c 70; echo; done
